com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Assign one invoice to an active client in the same workspace. The invoice's saved financial values remain unchanged. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: Preview assigning the invoice we selected to the active client we just found. Show both record IDs and the existing assignment, then wait for my confirmation.
